metadata.title: तानसा नेशनल पार्क के आदिवासियों के साहस और जीत की कहानी | Tansa National Park and Adivasis
metadata.description: The Tansa National Park of Maharashtra is famous for at least 92 species of flora and fauna. A special species of wild owl is found here which is now considered rare. This sanctuary is also known for its beauty. But very few people know that Warli tribals also live in this forest. What are the struggles of these Adivasis ? Please watch this very special episode of Main Bhi Bharat.
